text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of racing through the
Twinkle Series alongside Rose Kingdom drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Rose Kingdom radiated a brilliance that eclipsed all others,
steadily establishing its prominence in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And what the central figure behind it all, Rose Kingdom,
is pouring her utmost efforts into right now is—

text_block_list.name: Retired Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm thinking of establishing a junior club
in the Kinki region. Here are the materials...
and I wanted to ask everyone for their know-how.

text_block_list.name: Retired Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's up in Tohoku, but in our case—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was to provide a salon
to connect retired Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: As I walked the path of the Twinkle Series, I received the aid of many people and Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Founding the Rose Kingdom, establishing its presence,
and guiding it toward tranquility—none of this could have been achieved alone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It was precisely because they connected and joined their strength
that it swelled into a great wave, forging a path toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —I wish to put what I have learned here to good use for the racing world as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I wish to build a place where retired Umamusume
can gather, connect, and aid one another.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Among retired Umamusume,
many remain involved in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Some served as instructors,
some established racing clubs,
and others were involved in the racing business.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand—once everyone graduates from Tracen Academy,
their paths will naturally diverge.
In other words, the chances to spend time together are surprisingly fleeting.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Thus, I wish to establish a new setting for such occasions. Fortunately, given my lineage, I possess some expertise in arranging social gatherings.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...If they join hands,
they will surely achieve something magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It may even be possible to make the
racing world itself rock-solid.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This, I feel, is what must be done—as Rose Kingdom, bearer of the Rose lineage.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Could I ask you to lend me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... with the help of classmates who supported the idea,
and after thorough preparation—
the very first social gathering was held.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My... All of you will be helping
run the junior club's tournament next time?

text_block_list.name: Retired Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: Yes. We figured that by leveraging our respective positions, we could put on an even better event.

text_block_list.name: Retired Umamusume D
text_block_list.text: We were classmates back during our Tracen Academy days. And now... one's a junior club instructor, another's a horseshoe wholesaler, and the other manages a training facility.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I see. For former classmates to reunite like this...
What a lovely circle has been woven.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Its chief aim is mutual prosperity... yet it may also serve
simply as a tranquil haven to reminisce about the past.
I see, a remarkably generous concept.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely the heartfelt bonds forged in such gatherings
that serve as the cornerstone for our future prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Joining hands with the Rose Clan to achieve results—
a sound decision, and very characteristic of you, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
—However, as far as I am concerned, it was not
only the Rose Clan whose hands we joined.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Especially with you, my classmates...
Within the Twinkle Series, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Even today, Ruler called out to the academy
alumni, and Flash-senpai lent a hand
with managing the schedule.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Pisa gracefully bridged the conversation between the attendees, keeping the dialogue flowing smoothly—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of everyone's help
that this sight has come to be.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Quite unintentionally, you ended up embodying
the very concept of this gathering.
Allow me to express my heartfelt gratitude to you once more.

text_block_list.name: Retired Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so very much for granting us
such a wonderful opportunity today!

text_block_list.name: Retired Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I got to hear so much useful advice,
and my motivation's totally through the roof!
I'll definitely be joining next time too!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your kind words.
Even so, this is only the beginning.
I would be eager to hear any areas for improvement as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Whether these ride the wave of success hinges entirely on the momentum we build from here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that night,
upon returning home, Rose Kingdom invited me out for a stroll on the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I simply thought it wouldn't be so bad
to take a stroll together through a place like this once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the usual roar of the crowds, this tranquil turf
has a distinct charm of its own.
At the very least, I am quite fond of it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I hope you enjoy yourself as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She walked with deliberate steps across the very turf
where she usually broke sweat and chased after victory.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
The long-cherished ambition of the Rose Kingdom is finally on course.
Even without my constant intervention,
it will surely pave its own path to the future.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So next time—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to live for the advancement of the horse girl world... and for the lasting peace of all within it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Is it too presumptuous a dream, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having brilliantly fulfilled the Rose Clan's long-cherished dream and illuminated its future,
there is nothing she cannot achieve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before her, gazing quietly into the future
under the starry sky—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, a familiar line I'd heard so many times crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Matriarch's Trainer
text_block_list.text: 'O glorious Rose Clan.'
choice_data_list: 華やかなる“薔薇の王”よ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When he knelt before the ancestor and swore his vow back then—
did a fire burn deep within his chest as he forged those words, too?
choice_data_list: 大志を成し遂げるその時まで――
choice_data_list_en: Until the moment that grand ambition is fulfilled—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
choice_data_list: 必ず御傍で支えましょう
choice_data_list_en: I shall remain by your side to support you, without fail.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...'Our wish is but one', is it...?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I accept your vow.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I have not yet given up
on reaching it with my own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
We shall achieve it without fail.
Together, with our own hands.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: So that we may entrust a dazzling, boundless garden of flowers to the girls of tomorrow.
